title: Customer Issue Triage Assistant
problem: Route incoming tickets to the right queue
metrics: category accuracy >= 80% on 10 labeled synthetic tickets
build: classify with explicit keyword rules; unknown cases go to review
test: Compare predicted category to the labeled fixture; test empty input.

title: Internal Knowledge Assistant
problem: Answer questions using approved policy documents
metrics: retrieve relevant document in top 3 for at least 8 of 10 questions
build: rank passages by term overlap; surface supporting passages and abstain if none match
test: Check relevant passage IDs and an out-of-scope question.

title: Customer Onboarding Automation
problem: Convert a customer brief into a reviewable checklist
metrics: capture at least 8 of 10 expected requirements
build: extract labeled requirements and create a checklist requiring human approval
test: Check omitted requirements and reject invalid approval transitions.

title: CRM and Workflow Integrator
problem: Synchronize mock customer-created events to local tasks
metrics: one task per unique event; zero duplicate tasks
build: validate events and persist unique IDs in a transaction
test: Deliver the same event twice; verify one task exists.

title: AI-Powered Product Feedback Analyzer
problem: Group comments into themes with traceable evidence
metrics: 8 of 10 comments assigned to expected themes
build: group comments with deterministic categories and preserve source IDs
test: Test mixed and unknown feedback; reconcile all counts.

title: Production Incident Copilot
problem: Summarize synthetic alerts and draft a status update
metrics: all supplied impact facts cited and no invented root cause
build: sort events, summarize known facts, mark unknowns and require review
test: Test missing events and check that uncertain claims remain labeled.

title: End-to-End Customer Solution
problem: Deliver one integrated pilot backed by evidence
metrics: meet declared quality target on ten fixtures and pass access tests
build: combine a UI, trusted API, database, model adapter, policy and telemetry
test: Run valid, malformed and denied access cases; test rollback.
